answer: A harbor pilot license is issued only when the applicant locks a 130-unit deposit for eleven days and grows a vine of five timed surveys. Each survey is a 28-minute VDF over H(prior-survey || salted berth-log), and the fifth becomes the ripple seal. Two already-licensed pilots from disjoint quay neighborhoods, sharing no sponsor, must countersign that seal. If two surveys collide on a 10-bit prefix, or the same custody root appears on two live licenses, the deposit is slashed 70% and that vine is retired with no resubmit. A pilot may countersign at most one ripple seal per day.
